name: chess-master
description: Production-ready Chess App with Flutter frontend and Cloudflare Workers backend

scripts.build:frontend: cd app && flutter build web --release && cd .. && python3 scripts/prune_web_chunks.py
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy app/build/web --project-name=chessmaster-app
scripts.deploy:frontend:staging: npm run build:frontend && npx wrangler pages deploy app/build/web --project-name=chess-master-staging
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run deploy:backend
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run deploy:frontend:staging && npm run deploy:backend:staging
scripts.install: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
